notes.title: Update V1.1
notes.content:
[b]Our first update is out with a few small gameplay changes for an even better gaming experience.
[/b]
- Balancing the different difficulty modes
- The "Hard" difficulty is really tough now!
- More variations of the games in the different difficulty modes
- The party mode now comes with different difficulty levels of the games
- No more waiting times after winning the games! Winning a game now reduces the waiting time.
